items.title: 3 Super-Regional Banks Still Crushing Dividend Payouts Even After the Rate Whiplash
items.summary: Rate whiplash cracked the dividend promises of plenty of regional banks over the last two years, but a handful of super-regionals kept writing checks and even raised them. The question is whether their capital cushions are thick enough to keep it up, or whether the stress is just arriving late.
